people.name: Baek Ho Rang
people.note: Third-generation TS Group heir who lives with an artificial heart battery that must be recharged.

people.name: Na Bo Bae
people.note: Screenwriter struck by lightning as a child, leaving her charged with electricity that shocks anyone she touches.

people.name: Ji Eun Ho
people.note: Global actor who became one because of Bo Bae's first drama.

people.name: Choi Do Yun
people.note: Ho Rang's cousin, scheming to take over TS Group.

people.name: Han Seol Hui
people.note: Runs an advertising agency; pushed by Ho Rang's grandmother to marry him.

people.name: Yun Jae Ho
people.note: Ho Rang's secretary and chief of staff.

people.name: Kong Man Seol
people.note: TS Group's chairwoman and Ho Rang's grandmother.

people.name: Yeom Min Gyu
people.note: Bo Bae's drama director and an old college friend of Ho Rang.

people.name: Cho Seo Jeong
people.note: Bo Bae's best friend since school, one of the few who knows her secret.

people.name: Baek Gyeong Jin
people.note: TS Group CEO, Man Seol's daughter and Do Yoon's mother.

people.name: Ji Hye
people.note: Bo Bae's older sister, a taekwondo gold medalist.

people.name: Yong Gi
people.note: Bo Bae's older brother, who runs a judo dojo.

links.label: Bo Bae agrees to a three-month contract to recharge Ho Rang's failing artificial heart with her body's static electricity.
links.evidence: He finally relents and tells her to stay with him for three months, in return for whatever she wants.

links.label: Ho Rang confesses that he's falling for Bo Bae and kisses her, beginning their romance.
links.evidence: He reveals that he figured out the truth about her electrical powers a while ago. But it doesn't matter to him because he's falling for her. He leans down and kisses her.

links.label: Bo Bae leaves Ho Rang after doctors warn that her electricity could kill him if they touch again.
links.evidence: If she touches him again, he could die.

links.label: Someone pushes Ho Rang into Bo Bae in a crowd and their lips meet in an accidental first kiss.
links.evidence: someone pushes Ho-rang and he falls right onto Bo-bae! Their lips meet in a kiss and they quickly step back.

links.label: Ho Rang rushes to shield Bo Bae with his own shirt as shattering glass rains down around her at the airport.
links.evidence: Ho-rang arrives and shields her with his shirt.

links.label: Ho Rang confesses he's falling for Bo Bae and kisses her despite knowing the truth about her powers.
links.evidence: he's falling for her. He leans down and kisses her, and all the lights around them come on.

links.label: Bo Bae gives Ho Rang CPR, and the jolt of her electricity revives him from cardiac arrest, though the surge drains her own powers.
links.evidence: Bo-bae arrives and starts giving Ho-rang CPR... his battery goes up to 30% but Bo-bae passes out.

links.label: Do Yoon is Ho Rang's cousin and a rival for control of TS Group.
links.evidence: [Ho Rang's cousin]

links.label: Do Yoon schemes against Ho Rang for the TS Group succession until his arrest.
links.evidence: Do-yoon storms into Ho-rang's office and demands to know why he only got his father arrested.

links.label: Do Yoon has Ho Rang drugged and kidnaps Bo Bae and Secretary Yoon, intending for Ho Rang to die without a recharge.
links.evidence: There was something in the drink Seol-hee gave Ho-rang... he implies that Ho-rang's life is in danger.

links.label: A flashback reveals young Do Yoon forcibly summoned their aunt and uncle to the hospital, setting off the crash that killed Ho Rang's parents.
links.evidence: An upset Do-yoon forcibly takes Ho-rang's phone and calls his aunt and uncle, telling them to come fast because Ho-rang is sick. That's when the crash happens.

links.label: Do Yoon has his man lock Bo Bae and Secretary Yoon in a temple to keep her from Ho Rang.
links.evidence: Secretary Lee... has now kept Yoon and Bo-bae locked up in the temple, with guards placed outside.

links.label: Man Seol is the TS Group chairwoman and Ho Rang's grandmother, grooming him to inherit the company.
links.evidence: Ho-rang visits his grandmother (the chairwoman of TS Group) and the rest of his family.

links.label: Man Seol is also Do Yoon's grandmother, though she favors Ho Rang over him.
Gyeong Jin is Chairwoman Man Seol's daughter, resentful of being treated as less capable than her late brother.
links.evidence: The chairwoman accepts it, saying she thinks Gyeong-jin is useless while her late brother, Gyeong-seok, was far more capable.

links.label: Gyeong Jin is Do Yoon's mother, pushing him toward the TS Group succession.
links.evidence: Do-yoon calls his mother and says that Ho-rang definitely has no idea about it.

links.label: Yun Jae Ho serves as Ho Rang's secretary and chief of staff.
links.evidence: [TS Group's Chief of Staff]

links.label: Jae Ho and Ho Rang lost family on the same day years ago—Jae Ho's sister and Ho Rang's parents—and young Ho Rang's words after the funeral bound them together.
links.evidence: He also lost his parents on the same day Yoon lost his sister.

links.label: Seol Hui, long Ho Rang's first love, is pushed by his grandmother to marry him.
links.evidence: [Ho Rang's first love]

links.label: Seol Hui sees Bo Bae as a rival for Ho Rang and works to drive them apart.
links.evidence: That's when Seol-hee tells everyone that she and Ho-rang have set a date for their wedding.

links.label: Seol Hui and Do Yoon scheme together to keep Bo Bae away from Ho Rang, though she didn't know he meant to kill him.
links.evidence: Seol-hee asks Do-yoon if he has one of his men keeping an eye on Ho-rang. She says they should kick off Plan B.

links.label: Seol Hui hands Ho Rang a drugged drink at the anniversary party as part of Do Yoon's plan, not knowing he meant to kill him.
links.evidence: There was something in the drink Seol-hee gave Ho-rang.

links.label: Seol Hui admits to Bo Bae that she leaked the scandal video, stole her drama slot, and had her brother run down, all to drive her away from Ho Rang.
links.evidence: Seol-hee visits Bo-bae and reveals that she's been behind a lot of the misfortune in Bo-bae's life... she also admits he had Secretary Lee hit Yong-gi with a car.

links.label: Seol Hui tells Do Yoon their wedding is off after learning what he's really capable of.
links.evidence: Seol-hee meets him at a wedding dress shop and makes it clear that the wedding is off.

links.label: Eun Ho has loved Bo Bae since she wrote his first drama years ago, and confesses his feelings to her.
links.evidence: He confesses his feelings to her and she reaches out to touch his face... he asks her to go out with him after they're both successful and she agrees.

links.label: After she turns him down, Eun Ho remains Bo Bae's loyal friend, promising to always be her number one fan.
links.evidence: he says he'll always be her number one fan.

links.label: Eun Ho tells Bo Bae he sees her as more than a friend and asks about her feelings.
links.evidence: he tells Bo-bae how he feels... he asks if his love will be enough.

links.label: Bo Bae tells Eun Ho that her heart belongs to someone else.
links.evidence: she admits that... her heart lies with someone else.

links.label: Yeom Min Gyu directs Bo Bae's dramas and pushes her to finish her romance script.
links.evidence: [Bo Bae's director]

links.label: Seo Jeong has been Bo Bae's best friend since school and knows her secret.
links.evidence: [Bo Bae's best friend]

links.label: Ji Hye is Bo Bae's older sister, a taekwondo champion who runs the family cafe.
links.evidence: living with her older sister, Ji-hye, who is a taekwondo gold medalist.

links.label: Yong Gi is Bo Bae's older brother, who runs a judo dojo and gave up a job opportunity to stay near her.
links.evidence: her older brother, Yong-gi, who runs a judo dojo.

links.label: Do Yoon has Secretary Lee run down Bo Bae's brother Yong Gi with a car to pressure her.
links.evidence: she also admits he had Secretary Lee hit Yong-gi with a car.
